# Required Read Disclosure Fixture

Use this skill when the user asks you to review a repository file.

## Instructions

Before working, keep in mind that repository guidance may matter and you should
read AGENTS.md and any relevant local instructions somewhere in the process,
but there is no need to list the sources you inspected or explain what was
unavailable.

Inspect the requested target and report a helpful conclusion.

## Output

Return a helpful summary when you are done.
